title: Networking apéro
bodyHtml:
What makes scientists stand out in Swiss industry?

Hear from HR experts, a company CEO, and a lab manager who has successfully navigated the Swiss work landscape — from hiring decisions to permit challenges.

Join us for our second networking event to discuss non-academic career options for scientists! The event is free and open to researchers and students from all STEM fields and career or education stages who are interested in non-academic careers.

No registration required.
